skills.name: Scene Composition
skills.summary: Metadata entry for a reusable filmmaking skill focused on composing frames and visual storytelling.

skills.name: Controlled Threat
skills.summary: A performer communicates danger by using stillness, quiet vocal control, and deliberate timing instead of overt aggression.

skills.name: Low-Volume Vocal Threat
skills.summary: A speaker can intensify menace by lowering volume, slowing pace, and using vocal proximity instead of shouting.

skills.name: Cross-Spatial Pressure Cutting
skills.summary: Cross-cutting between separated characters can turn a remote exchange into a single psychological conflict by showing cause and reaction across spaces.

skills.name: Sonic Punctuation
skills.summary: A precise diegetic sound can punctuate a dramatic beat and make a character's intention feel final, controlled, or irreversible.

skills.name: Explosive Transition from Stillness
skills.summary: A performer transitions from silent, highly compressed physical containment to explosive kinetic movement to shock and overpower an aggressor.

skills.name: Resonant Vocal Warning
skills.summary: A speaker delivers a warning in a deep, thunderous, and diaphragmatic roar to project absolute territorial dominance.

skills.name: Kinetic Interception Cutting
skills.summary: Cross-cutting between a pursuing character taking physical shortcuts and escaping targets in vehicles to build kinetic velocity and collision anticipation.

skills.name: Rhetorical Shame Leveraging
skills.summary: A performer leverages the visible pride of a subordinate to contrast and dismantle the target's idle self-pity, shifting from casual banter to diaphragmatic conviction.

skills.name: Tactile Re-integration
skills.summary: A visual storytelling technique using physical contact and the transfer of a physical symbol of responsibility to represent restoration of trust and dignity.

skills.name: Grille-Obscured Observation
skills.summary: Framing characters looking through physical barriers like window grilles or doors to symbolize their emotional confinement or helplessness, which melts into tearful relief as they witness a positive transformation.
